why: newest release at least two weeks old (D1)
evidence: npm view pyodide time; 314.0.7 lock info

decision: lxml 6.1.3, Pillow 12.2.0, typing_extensions 4.15.0 from the Pyodide distribution
why: the distribution ships all three for this ABI; typing_extensions there is the same pure wheel the spec says to vendor
result: self-hosted from docs/ with the rest

decision: python-pptx 1.0.2 and XlsxWriter 3.2.9 vendored wheels
why: XlsxWriter 3.3.0 is 7 days old, under the two-week floor

decision: CPython venv pins the same lxml, Pillow, python-pptx, XlsxWriter, typing_extensions as the browser
why: C10 compares XML from both runtimes

decision: any DOCTYPE in any XML part is bad_file
why: OOXML parts never carry one; refusing all is a superset of 'DOCTYPE with entities'

decision: python-pptx parser left as shipped: resolve_entities=False, no_network and huge_tree at lxml defaults (on, off)
why: it only sees XML that passed deckfill's safe parser; test asserts it does not expand entities

decision: lying member size gives bad_file
why: Python zipfile reads at most the declared size, then the CRC fails; caps also counted on bytes read

decision: integrity check allows an empty r:id
why: PowerPoint writes r:id="" on action links (next slide); it names no relationship

decision: kept parts = parts reachable from the package root
why: python-pptx loads by walking relationships; an orphan member nothing points to is not part of the template's look

decision: remove the whole p14:sectionLst and custShowLst
why: every sample slide goes, so every section and custom show would be empty; new slides belong to none

decision: docProps/app.xml: Slides, Notes, HiddenSlides counts updated; TitlesOfParts left
why: titles are positional and localised; counts are what PowerPoint shows

decision: a bullet line between # and the first ## joins the subtitle, mark removed
why: D2 is silent; this loses no text

decision: ### and deeper headings are read as plain lines, warned heading_level
why: not part of D2; keeps the text

decision: a # line after the first ## is read as ## and warned second_title
why: D2 says at most one #; a late one is the second

decision: '-', '*', '1.', '1)' need a space after the mark; '•·‧', '1、', '一、' do not
why: so -5%, *重要*, 1.5 億 stay text

decision: plain lines take indent level like bullets; no bullet-off formatting is written
why: fill sets no paragraph formatting beyond level (D4)

decision: a # needs whitespace after it; '#標題' is a plain line
why: D2 format is '# '; avoids hashtags becoming titles

decision: typed layouts outside step 1's list (objTx, picTx, vertTx, blank) go to step 2
why: step 1 lists only these types
evidence: typed fixture: Content with Caption is two by step 2, after Two Content in order

decision: column pair = the two largest bodies that do not overlap horizontally, ordered by x
why: Comparison has two small header bodies and two content bodies; columns are the content ones

decision: when the class default and its named fallbacks have no destination, the first compatible layout in file order
why: D3 step 4 lists fallbacks for title, two, section only

decision: normAutofit is modelled at full size; only spAutoFit counts as shape autofit
why: Office's default body carries normAutofit; marking it unmodelled would mark nearly every slide; estimating at 100% is the conservative side

decision: percent line spacing = 1.2 em x percent; percent space before/after on the same scale; no space before the first paragraph; marL narrows the width
why: PowerPoint single spacing is about 1.2 em and ignores space before on the first paragraph

decision: footer step 3 applies when steps 1 and 2 found no example slide
why: a template whose only sample is a cover still has p:hf to follow for content slides

decision: step 2 skips title-class layouts on both sides: a new title-class slide only takes footers from step 1
why: spec text; C4 footer-active expects no footer on the title slide

decision: a copied footer goes only onto a layout that has that placeholder type; its idx is set to the layout's
why: a slide placeholder inherits its place from the layout by idx

decision: step 3 adds ftr only when the layout's footer placeholder holds text
why: an empty footer box is an empty box (C6)

decision: python-pptx default master: dt idx 10, ftr idx 11, sldNum idx 12 on the master and every layout; no p:hf; no slide shows them
why: D4 asks the seat to log it
result: footers added only by D4 rules

decision: main content types accepted: presentation, template, slideshow (rewritten to presentation); macro-enabled refused as not_pptx
why: python-pptx would open .pptm but macros are out of scope

result: BLOCKED: needs Marco to run the install or allow it

decision: playwright-core 1.64.1 (2026-10-14) driving the cached chromium_headless_shell-1243 by executablePath

why: spec D7 names it; the verb tip is a recommendation, the lowercase-hyphen rule is the requirement
